_note: Phase 2, measured against the real twin-wasm solver on an idle machine. Study area is the default radius-4 block around Fairfax City: 36,166 edges, 6,269 overlay paths at z11. firstBaselineMs is a real equilibrium assignment of hour 8, not a stub. Not comparable to the Phase-1 numbers, which predate the graph load and the overlay.
_fps: Unmeasured. With the deck.gl overlay on, the scripted pan/tilt path saturates the page main thread badly enough under swiftshader that the CDP channel is starved and the first pass never returns - so the harness banks each zoom as it lands and leaves these null rather than hanging the run. The regression gate skips non-finite metrics. Record them on a machine with a real GPU; Phase 1 saw 6.2-6.7 fps here with no overlay.
